name: @dimension/community-swiss-knife
author: Dimension
description: Small useful things for the agent, in one switch: `present` shows you a file as a card, the Viewer MCP App opens and annotates it, and a stream rule stops the agent mid-edit when it writes a code comment.
//devDependencies: viewer/src is bundled into viewer/app/server.mjs and viewer/app/view into viewer/app/dist by viewer/scripts/build.mjs, and src is bundled into dist/index.mjs by scripts/build.mjs, so none of this ships. The document parsers (docx-preview, jszip, @aiden0z/pptx-renderer, xlsx) are declared here even though the docx/pptx/xlsx renderers are written elsewhere: one manifest owns the whole dependency set. `xlsx` is SheetJS CE from SheetJS's own CDN because the npm `xlsx` package is frozen at 0.18.5 (2022) with known advisories.
